'''[[Vulderania system/Legends|Vulderanian]] grain flakes''' were a bland type of dehydrated food. A case was accidentally mislaid on board the [[Machine Tool Storage Unit Alpha-Four]], enabling the stowaway [[Celot Ratua Dil]] to survive while effecting his escape from [[Despayre]] to the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]].
